articleTitle: A Real-Time Information System for BRT Based on GPS/Signpost Compound Navigation Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The initial real-time information system for Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) is based on Global Positioning System (GPS) in Ji'nan, it can't provide accurate real-time information of buses arrival/departure at stop, and missing data of GPS is often found, especially under elevated highway or in bad weather. The papers put forward a new way to provide real-time transit information for BRT based on GPS/Signpost compound Automatic Vehicle Location (AVL) technology. Compared the traditional signpost system, the upgrade system locates bus accurate position of arrival/departure at stop via the existing BRT platform facility which is called Platform Screen Doors (PSDs) system, only when the bus stops at depot within a permissible error range, the driver can open/close PSDs using Onboard transmitter to send out a signal which is received by Platform receivers which is mounted at Platform edge. Using the existing resource, the upgrade system combines GPS and Signpost or called PSDs system in this article to provide real-time information about transit services to passengers in Ji'an BRT system. The passengers are satisfied with real-time transit information, particularly accurate information of buses arrival and departure at stop. And it can make up the drawbacks of failing to disseminate bus location due to missing data of GPS.

articleTitle: Study on the Drink Driving Behavior of Drivers in Beijing Based on the Theory of Plan Behavior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Rapid development of the Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) has greatly increased the traffic safety. In order to improving the safety status caused by drink driving in China, a questionnaire study was conducted with drink driving behaviors in Beijing to help understand the attitude, subjective norm, perceive behavioral control and intentions of drink driving in Beijing using the theory of planned behavior (TPB). The direct and indirect factors involved in self-reported drink driving behaviors are examined. Perceived behavioral control appears to be the best direct predictor of self-reported drink driving behavior. Subjective norms and intentions have weaker direct links with drink driving behavior. Past drink driving experience is the obvious factor which greatly effects the attitudes, subjective norms, perceive behavioral control and intentions of the drink driving. Subsequently, some advice on the development of ITS technology and products for drink driving behavior is suggested.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology for Improving Safe Awareness Based on Driving Simulator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Statistical data shows that a driver who was lack of the ability to discover potential risk situation and safe driving awareness was more probably to cause an accident. The safe driving awareness was considered as a factor in contributing to vehicle crashes. In this study, a creative method to improve safety awareness based on driving simulator was proposed. Firstly, the definition and classification of safety driving awareness was analyzed. Second, the procedure for drivers appropriately control vehicle to response to risk situation was discussed. The compositions, characteristic parameters, trigger condition and implements mode of risk situation were all designed and then implemented to generate a virtual driving scenario according to characteristic of simulation driving. Finally, one experimental group of 10 middle-aged participants were subject to driver training and driving skills were constantly assessed and corrected to ensure effective vehicle handling and control for evasive driving. The results indicated that the participants reduced their speed sooner when approaching hazards, and braked earlier than untrained drivers. Meanwhile the improvement of safe driving awareness is found for all the participants after hands-on practice in lifelike simulation scenarios. Therefore, the simulator is a valuable tool for drivers statewide to develop a conditioned response to a given risky situation and to improve the safety driving awareness.

articleTitle: Mineral Particle Image Processing and Parameter Extracting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The grain size is an important quality index of granular materials. The accurate measurement of it has a guiding significance for technical performances and application of subsequent processing. Currently most of particle detection are done by manual operation such as screening method, which causes many problems as time-consuming measurement and lengthy testing steps. The particle size detection technology in this paper can be obtained from artificial disturbance, and can get consistent, objective testing results, representing the development direction of particle detection.

articleTitle: A Network Equilibrium Model for Emergency Logistics Response under Disaster Spreading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Quick and accurate response to the relief demand is vital to an emergency logistics network under disaster spreading. In this paper, we first characterize the disaster spreading process to forecast the time-varying relief demand, by using an epidemic model to analyze the relationships among three groups of affected individuals. Then, a new three-tiered emergency logistics network equilibrium model is formulated to satisfy the predicted urgent demand with the least relief cost, in particular the time cost. We perform numerical simulation to demonstrate the effectiveness of our model, and discuss the impact of the important parameters.

articleTitle: Developing a Model for the Emergency Rescue Routing Problem Using Stochastic Programming Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: According to the randomness and weak economy properties of the Emergency Rescue Routing Problem (ERRP), a chance-constrained programming model is constructed based on a stochastic road network. In this model, we consider there are multiple emergency rescue departments serving for a single emergency site, and the travel times between any two nodes are stochastic variables. As the stochastic ERRP is NP-hard and more complex in computation than a shortest path problem in the corresponding deterministic road network, a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm embedded with stochastic simulation is proposed to solve the chance-constrained programming model. Simulation results show that the algorithm is efficient to solve the stochastic ERRP. It can minimize the total travel cost of all rescue vehicles under the time constraints with high reliability. The algorithm can be extended for other NP-hard stochastic programming problems or shortest path problems.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual-Band Dipole Antenna for RFID Tag
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper analyzes the slotted microstrip antenna equivalent circuit and the slot theory, and then describes a novel slot-coupled dual-band dipole antenna for RFID tag. The proposed antenna uses a novel compact structure and reduces the area of antenna by 15% or more than similar antennas. Simulated results computed by HFSS 10 indicate that the impedance bandwidths (less than -10dB) of this antenna are 810MHz~960MHz and 2.26GHz~2.61GHz. The relative bandwidths of this antenna are 16.6% and 14.3%. The radiation characteristics of this novel antenna also have good performance on 910MHz and 2.45GHz.

articleTitle: The Grid-Computing Based Instrumented Monitoring Platform for Cold Chain Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Due to the characteristics of cold chain logistics, this paper proposes a model of a multi-level-instrumented physical monitoring platform based on ZigBee and RFID technologies and Grid computing management system. Information about food products and their environments can be gathered and processed throughout the logistic chain in real time, thus the system model can facilitate more accurate monitoring and control of the cold chain logistics, and improve the logistic service level.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Network Management System Based on XML View
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Since the late 1980s, the simple network management protocol (SNMP) as the Internet management standard has been developed. The management of IP networks has exclusively relied on the SNMP. But the SNMP management framework has some weaknesses especially related to extensibility configuration management and efficient application development processes. Today, researchers and developers in the network and system management area have begun to investigate the use of Extensible Markup Language (XML) technologies seems to promise a fancy way out of this trouble. This paper introduces the concept of applying XML technologies to developing XML-based management systems to solve the problems that exist in the SNMP-based network management. We present a kind of network management system based XML which has advantage in platform-free, efficiency and flexibility. We have validated this architecture by implementing it and using it in managing network devices and systems.

articleTitle: Technical Measures of Fruit and Vegetable Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In this paper the necessity of strengthening transportation of fruit and vegetable is discussed systematically. And combined to the characteristic of fruit and vegetable,and the situation of cold storage transportation, storage and transportation relevant technique requirement of fruit and vegetables is analysed, such as temperature,humidity,gas composition,package and vibration, and according to experimental data, storage and transportation relevant technique requirement of fruit and vegetables are advanced. Finally a case study is carried out to analyse advantages of each mode, and probes into the feasibility of how to strengthen transportation of fruit and vegetable,and how to improve the quality of transportation.

articleTitle: The Optimization and Integration of the Transportation and Inventory Cost Based on Time in Supply Chain Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper puts forth a model of the transportation and inventory integration and optimization problem based on system and optimal theory which we take into account the antinomy relationship of transportation and inventory and the antinomy relationship of inventory and stock-out in supply chain logistics system. We consider that the resources available and the total time of inventory and transportation are limited.In the transportation process, transportation cost, transportation time and transportation capacity may vary between the two adjacent nodes for the reason of the transfer among various transportation modes. When the mode of the transportation is changed, we need consider the transshipment time and transshipment cost.The issue is a multi-transportation option network question under the normal distribution of the minimum total cost which consists of transportation cost, inventory cost, stock-out cost and time cost. In this paper, we comparatively study and specifically calculate the minimum total transportation and inventory cost in several different cases. Our paper shows that the result is not only more reasonable and effective than other models which can be seen in the appendix but also more in line with the actual situation of the supply chain logistics system. We can get our purpose that we may have a certain referential significance to reduce the total cost and raise the total profit of the supply chain logistics system.

articleTitle: Optimizing Berth Allocation by an Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In order to improve operation efficiency and customer satisfaction and to minimize the turnaround time of vessels at container terminals, a berth allocation problem (BAP) was formulated. An adaptive artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) was proposed to solve it. Firstly, the basic principle and the algorithm design of the AFSA were introduced. Then, for a test case, computational experiments explored the effect of algorithm parameters on the convergence of the algorithm. Experimental results show that the algorithm has better convergence performance than genetic algorithm (GA) and ant colony optimization (ACO). The improved algorithm with rational parameters can effectively solve the BAP.

articleTitle: GMDSS Automatic Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The current skill evaluation of GMDSS certification is mainly carried out by human being, which involves many man-made factors, and is hard to test the real level of personnel being assessed. Due to this fact, the present study designs an automatic evaluation system. Based on a B/S structure, the system realizes an automatic assessment content algorithm according to category and area. It simulates the real communication equipment, and at the same time records, assesses and plays back the whole evaluation process, which can effectively improve the accuracy of evaluation. Finally, an example is given to test the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: Supply Chain-Oriented Logistics Company Customer Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Customer relationship management is the product of advanced information technologies and the modern management science, customer relationship management strategy is important in modern logistics, establish a scientific and efficient logistics enterprise customer relationship management architecture, the architecture contains customer contact layer, management level and decision support layer. Several implementation key technologies of the logistics enterprise customer relationship management were explored.

articleTitle: Warehousing Planning and Design of Specialty Resources in Shangzhi Logistics Park
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Taking Shangzhi-Yiwu small commodities logistics park project planning as an example, this study focused on the design of specialty resource planning. To meet the business needs of ShangzhiYiwu small commodities sector, the planning was designed based on designated business volume and construction area of the warehousing as well as the characteristics of the resources stored in the warehouse. At the same time, the design must ensure the normal operation and the appropriate mechanical storage facilities.

articleTitle: Early Warning Index System for Natural Disasters Emergency Logistics Risks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Lots of risks existed in the process of Emergency Logistics especially when natural disasters happened. Evaluation research on Emergency Logistics Risks (ELR) is the basis of effective early warning and responding to risks, so it's of great theoretical and practical significance to establish an early warning index system for ELR. Firstly, some foundation research about ELR was carried out, including definition, characteristics, classification and controllability of ELR. An early warning index system for ELR was established. This system was a multi-level index system, and mainly evaluated by the decision-making risk, dispatching and commanding risk, organizing and coordinating risk, executing and controlling risk, resources supporting risk and their sub index. The establishment principles and significance of the index system were discussed. Then, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and Delphi method were used to confirm the index weight and value. Finally, a case analysis on ELR of Yushu earthquake was conducted to demonstrate the early warning index system and to evaluate the actual risk level.

articleTitle: Application for Bridge Strengthening Monitoring Based on FBG
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The deflection reasons for long-span prestressed concrete box-girder (LPCB) bridge are still ambiguous. This paper pointed out some outstanding advantages of using fiber optical sensing (FOS) technology in old LPCB Bridge strengthening monitoring. According to certain existing old LPCB Bridge strengthening monitoring example,it presented some direct and indirect monitoring indexes that should be contained in the old strengthening monitoring. The necessity of designing some monitoring subsystem enclosing the mentioned indicators based on optical fiber sensing technology was also presented. The main analysis results about partial external cables,cracks on girders and prestressing loss show that the method based upon FOS technology is superior to the traditional means.

articleTitle: A Dispatching Method for Trucks at Container Terminal by Using Fuzzy-CNP Concept
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: At container terminals, containers are transported from the marshalling yard to the quay and vice versa by Container Trucks (CTs). This study discusses how to dispatch CTs by utilizing information about pickup and delivery locations and time in future delivery tasks based on dynamic dispatching strategy in which multiple tasks are matched with multiple CTs. In this paper, Multi-agent system (MAS) is used as the basis for an intelligent dispatch system. Relationship between transport tasks and service of CTS has been taken as a contract net using the fuzzy set theory and method. Considering the load of communication and consultation efficiency in system, the bidirectional negotiation mechanism is adopted. The dispatching model based on Contract Network Protocol (CNP) using bidirectional negotiation is provided for assigning optimal delivery tasks to CTs and fuzzy reasoning process of dispatching decisions is suggested. The method has both virtues of precision of static planning and flexibility of CNP and has been confirmed by cases.

articleTitle: An Image-Based Object Detection Method Using Two Cameras
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: To develop a quick detection algorithm for the image-based autonomous vehicle (AV) or computer assisted driving system, this paper proposes a real-time object detection method using two coordinated cameras. The mapping between two simultaneous images from the two cameras and coordination of the virtual sensitive areas can be resolved using parameters like the camera shot angle, the camera focal length, and the virtual square which is the interested area. This calculation need minimum time and further object detection can be performed within the virtual area, which can considerably reduced the image size and accelerate the object detection. The method can be used for tailgating prevention or fast lane detection.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Model of the Diesel Locomotive Air Brake System Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Due to the configuration complexity of the diesel locomotive air brake system, it is difficult to realize the fault diagnosis on the brake system. In order to enhance fault diagnosis efficiency for diesel locomotive air brake system with uncertain fault, a fault diagnosis model based on Bayesian network is proposed in this paper. According to a priori exact probability or experts estimate that the probability, the classical Expectation-Maximization algorithm calculates the joint fault probability distribution and probability distribution of marginal respectively. Based on joint tree algorithm, Bayesian network is designed to infer the fault probabilities of components. The fault location could be realized. The simulation results indicate that the accurate fault probabilities could be calculated. Therefore, this method is effective for uncertain fault.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Relationship Management System for Logistics Company Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Logistics companies are typical enterprises depending on the maintenance of customer relationships, in which the customers are important resources. The establishment of a supply chain management concept and the implementation of customer relationship management are propitious to improve the competitiveness of logistics enterprises. In this paper, the necessity of the implementation of customer relationship management is analyzed from the viewpoint of the characteristics of logistics companies, and the approaches for logistics enterprises to effectively implement the customer relationship management are explored at the same time. The research can provide a theoretical support for logistics enterprises to implement customer relationship management. Experience has shown that establishing a customer-requirement-centric customer relationship management orienting supply chain is the source of competitive advantage in logistics companies. It also can become non-imitated barriers in the competition among logistics companies.

articleTitle: Analysis Framework of SC Recycling Process Based on SD
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The mechanism of recycling system about discarded products is running with a few critical roles and processes. For the sake of verifying its complex relationship the paper explores and identifies the critical drivers underlying the system, based on which a framework is established to explore the relationship among relevant activities consisted of collection, remanufacturing and resale, as well as companies and customers' behaviours. This scenario demonstrates and verifies the rule of recycling activities, which will contribute a lot in terms of the recycling operation in practice.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Algorithm for the Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Vehicle routing problem is an important combinatorial optimization problem. It has an important position in logistics optimization and supply chain management theory. Due to traffic flow, traffic incidents and other factors, the travel speed and travel time of road has large time-variability and randomness in real transport network. The study of vehicle routing problem in time-dependent network has even more practical value. This paper combines features of time-dependent networks and gives the mathematical models of time-dependent vehicle routing problem. On this basis, the traditional ant colony optimization algorithm is improved. A new path transfer strategy of ants and new dynamic pheromone update strategy applicable to time-dependent network are proposed. Based on these strategies, the improved ant colony algorithm is given for solving the vehicle routing problem in time-dependent network. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively solve the vehicle routing problem in time-dependent network and has better computational efficiency and convergence speed.

articleTitle: Rail Crew Scheduling Based on a Pooling Mode for High Speed Passenger Lines
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Rail high-speed passenger lines (HSPL) have been developed rapidly in China; however, the traditional rail crew scheduling mode called responsible mode, in which crews are bundled with vehicles, is hard to adapt to the transit characteristic of HSPL. Moreover, the utilization of rail crew resources is commonly inefficient and the scheduling methods are generally behindhand. To reduce the pressure of high cost and lacking qualified crew in HSPL, a pooling crew scheduling mode should be applied and would be a trend, which can help rail agencies increase the utilization of crew resources and managerial levels. Under the pooling mode, the crew scheduling problem becomes much more complicated, known to be NP-hard. A set covering model is applied, in which the variables represent precompiled potential shifts and each shift must conform to a set of labor agreement rules. The model is solved by ILOG - an advanced optimization tool and tested with a real-world problem instance, which is abstracted from Guangzhou-Shenzhen high-speed line. The computational results show that the model and method are effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Emergency Logistics Design in Disasters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Logistics programming in natural involves dispatching commodities to distribution centres in disaster areas as soon as possible so that relief operations are accelerated. In this study, three planning models are to be integrated into a natural disaster logistics decision support system. The system readily decomposed into three problems the first one being fuzzy clustering disaster grades by historical data, the second one showing the grade distinguishment of new disaster areas based on fisher discrimination procedure, the last one giving plan incorporating relief commodities and equipment distributing in proper sequence in disaster areas. In emergency logistics context, supply is available in limited quantities at current time period but commodity demand is known with uncertainty at the time. So how to make grate use of the limited commodities under the uncertainty information, that is of great value. The mathematical models describe setting are considerably different than other conventional vehicle routing problem articles in the world. It suggests that macro adjustment is needed in emergency logistics programming in natural disasters, and it will drow more attention to this field in the near future.

articleTitle: Financial Competitiveness Evaluation of Chinese Listed Companies of Electrical Equipment Section: Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Financial competitiveness is the embodiment of the company competitiveness. It is important for investors or company itself to evaluate the financial competitiveness. In this paper, a financial competitiveness evaluation model based on the method of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) was built which includes 15 indicators in four areas of solvency, operational capacity, profitability and development capacity. Then financial competitiveness of 27 listed companies in the electrical equipment section was evaluated based on financial statement data from three years of 2007 to 2009. The evaluation results can provide reference to the investors, creditors and stakeholders when they make a decision.

articleTitle: Study on Short-Time Traffic Flow Forecasting Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This thesis introduces the forecasting methods of domestic and foreign road traffic flow, analyzes the advantages and shortcomings of all sorts of traffic flow forecasting methods and the actual forecasting effects. For the complexity of the urban traffic, the precision of some current traffic flow forecasting methods is not high. With respect to these questions, this thesis applies the chaotic neural network to establish the chaotic neural network forecasting model of traffic flow of urban intersection exit. Compared with the forecasting results obtained by the traditional BP neural network and exponential smoothing method, it is showed that such model has highly good effect.

articleTitle: A Variable Neighborhood Tabu Search Algorithm for the Heterogeneous Fleet Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The heterogeneous fleet vehicle routing problem with time windows is a variant of the classical vehicle routing problem. This paper defines a mathematical model of this problem and proposes a variable neighborhood tabu search algorithm to solve it. The initial solution is obtained by GENIUS and the giant tour algorithm. Our algorithm employs a variable neighborhood mechanism to search the optimal solution based upon four neighborhoods. In addition, the local search results are improved by the tabu search algorithm. The proposed algorithm appears to be effective when tested on benchmark instances from the literature.

articleTitle: Acceleration Slip Regulation of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: To maintain the stability of the vehicle and to guarantee the traction performance, an acceleration slip regulation (ASR) system is proposed for a front-axle drive electric passenger car. The control strategy of ASR based on the ASR system mentioned above is developed, which is realized in MATLAB/Stateflow. In order to study the characteristics of the ASR system better and to evaluate the performance of the developed control strategy, road tests are performed on different road surfaces and the test results show that the developed control strategy can be beneficial to both the stability and the traction performance of the electric passenger car.

articleTitle: An Optimization Research of Power Generation Equipment Management Based on Life Cycle Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This article takes the Life Cycle Cost (LCC) of power generation equipment as the Optimization object, to establish a complete optimization program for equipment management in the equipment life cycle. The key links of the life cycle will be found by the technical and economical methods, and then certain technical and management methods will be used to realize the optimization of the key links. The purpose of the optimization research is to reduce the life cycle cost of power generation equipment and to achieve the optimization of equipment management.

articleTitle: Optimization and Simulation of Storage Location Assignment in AS/RS Based on FLEXSIM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The paper has constructed the mathematical model on the storage location assignment in AS/RS, and then optimized and solved it, performed instance simulation design and analysis on the storage location assignment by means of Flexsim. Finally, we have concluded that the storage location assignment model after optimization would solve the storage location assignment problem in AS/RS effectively and improve the loading-unloading efficiency, as will provide technical support for the enterprise to improve efficiency and reduce cost.

articleTitle: Recent Challenges and New Methods in MIMO Channel Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper summaries the new topics about MIMO (Multiple-input-multiple-output) channel modeling. The scenarios are focused on transportation, such as VTV (Vehicle-to-Vehicle) and high speed railway. The sparse channel and time-variant channel are discussed. Afterwards, some novel methods for MIMO channel modeling are described and challenges for each method are summarized.

articleTitle: Regulation of Drivers' Distance Cognition Difference between Daytime and Night-Time
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In order to study the impact of drivers' distance cognition difference on traffic safety in dynamic environment of daytime and night-time, a real road tests was carried out by asking 19 drivers randomly selected to percept the distances of obstacles with different distances and velocities on daytime and nighttime. The values of cognition are obtained by statistical methods. The distance cognition difference is predicted in a simulation using BP neural network and the variation laws and impact on traffic safety are analyzed. Results demonstrate that BP neural network model can efficiently simulate the cognition difference which augments with distance increasing. With the same distance, the absolute distance cognitive difference first increases and then reduces as the speed increases; while the relative distance cognition difference first increases and then decreases only when the distance is small; and it first decreases followed by an increase , and then decreases again in case of a medium and long-distance.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Transport Chain between China and Austria
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Optimization of international transport chain may significantly contribute a successful outcome of international trade. The performance of various transport mode influences its selection. This paper analyses and compares the transport chain between China and Austria, aiming to identify the best practices and choose the optimal transport mode. Based on analyzing secondary data, the different transport modes are presented. The SWOT analysis was selected to analyze and compare the competitive operation of the various transport modes between China and Austria. It was explored the determinates of the selection of transport mode; The intermodal transport with sea & road and air transport are the main options; Also Price, timing, service grade and relationship with forwarder are the vital factors to the routine option between China and Austria. More secondary data should be used to validate the research in the future.

articleTitle: Spontaneous Combustion Prediction and Combustion Regime Analysis Basing on Experiments by Gas Ratio
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: It has been widely used to predict the spontaneous combustion in coalmines and it helps to improve the accuracy of prediction greatly because of their special characters such as unicity, regularity and sensibility. The indicator gases predicting coal spontaneous combustion are determined based on the law of gas released from oxidizing coal with temperature, and 4 judgment criteria are put forward for the combustion regime analysis, by them they can be used as auxiliary index for the spontaneous combustion prediction too. Combined with other indicator gases, it can help to improve the accuracy of prediction greatly and is helpful to the mine fire combat and protection.

articleTitle: Research on Information Process Reengineering of Logistics System Based on BPR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The information process is along with the whole material process in logistics system. It can improve the logistics efficiency and reduce logistics costs to manage and control the information process of logistics system. This paper redesigns the information process based on BPR (business process reengineering), and makes the logistics system of information process more smoothly and efficiently, and makes the management of logistics systems more scientific.

articleTitle: Application of GIS/GPS Technology in Mobile Logistics Public Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: this paper discusses how to apply the GIS/GPS technology to the common mobile Logistics business to meet the requirements of efficient Logistics management. In the full analysis of GIS (Geographic Information System) and GPS (Global Positioning System) technology superiority in Logistics, this paper focuses on the system design issues and principles, and puts forward a GIS/GPS based solution apply to Logistics business. A Mobile Logistics Public Information Platform (MLPIP) is designed independently. The system architecture, workflow and functional modules are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: On the Periods of Fibonacci Sequences Mod N
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: An upper bound for the smallest period of the Fibonacci module sequence is obtained, which is 6N, and more accurate and convenient than the current results. Since the smallest period of the Fibonacci module sequence is twice of that of two-dimensional Arnold transformation, the upper bound for the smallest module period of Arnold transformation is naturally 3N. It is a great advance compared with the existing best upper bound N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/2 in the literatures. Moreover, many important properties are gained, which provide new thought for study on the period of Arnold transformation and the necessary mathematical reference of image coding and processing.

articleTitle: A New Method of Abnormal Data Detection on Traffic Flow of Extra Long Highway Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Researched on the characteristic of the traffic flow, a new method of abnormal data detection on traffic flow based on the curve-fitting is presented. First, the historical data on traffic flow are divided into the traffic flow with high speed and the traffic flow with low speed by the clustering analysis. Then, the algorithm on the determination safety zone scope is obtained by the curve-fitting on the historical data and the undetermined abnormal data can be detected from the real-time traffic flow data for out of the calculated safety zone scope. Finally, the undetermined abnormal data are confirmed as the abnormal data which are even beyond the accepted error range. The real-time traffic flow data of an extra long highway tunnel in Shaanxi are taken as examples, and the detection result by the presented method shows that the abnormal data can be efficiently and effectively detected from the real-time data on traffic flow of extra long highway tunnel.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of the Information Service System for Taxi Business Based on GPS/GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: With the rapid development of automobile industry and public transport, how the information technology, such as GPS and GIS, can acclimate the need of this development, and get direct economic benefits, has become the focus of the whole society. The GPS/GIS information service system for taxi business, without changing the original mode and structure of the taxi operation system, offers services for the overall business, including information receiving and transmission, biding for business, conforming, taxi dispatching and customer-pickup and driving services for taxi reservation. Moreover, this system also provides the functions of communication, alarming, recording, navigating, positioning, tracing, monitoring and other information services.

articleTitle: The Moderating Effect of Switching Costs on Buyer Loyalty Formation: An Empirical Study of B2B e-Marketplace
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The purpose of this study was to identify switching costs and examine the moderating effect of switching costs on buyer loyalty model in the B2B e-marketplace. Then a questionnaire was constructed and data were collected from 649 buyers of a Chinese B2B e-marketplace in 114 countries all over the world. Multi-group analysis was applied to examine the moderating effect of switching costs. Finally, the results indicated that switching costs moderate the relationship between perceived quality and user satisfaction. In light of the major findings, the study provided managerial implications for B2B e-marketplace to enhance buyer loyalty through the management of switching costs.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design of Intersection Signal Phasing-Sequence Based on Procedural Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Conservation Schemes of Air-Conditioned Passenger Train Based on Sustainable Development Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The sustainable development energy strategy in China is a low carbon energy strategy. Based on it, several new schemes about energy-saving of air-conditioned train are discussed in this article. Such as: change the existing air-flow organization in the air-conditioning system; using the plate-fin heat exchangers to pre-treat the fresh air; according to the change of outdoor weather conditions, effectively adjust the air-conditioning system.

articleTitle: Behavior Analysis for Government and Enterprise in Home-Appliance Replacement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Home-appliance replacement may be implemented in two situations: with and without the financial subsidy offered by the government. As the implement entity of the home-appliance replacement, the enterprise may have two choices: with and without the replacement. In this paper, we analyzed the behaviors of the government and the enterprise based on a mixed-strategy game by system dynamics methodology. According to the simulation of the long term behavior, all of the enterprises will chose to carry out the replacement no matter with or without financial subsidy if they can obtain profit from the replacement; all of the enterprises will chose to give up the replacement even though with financial subsidy if they can't obtain profit from the replacement. It means that the government can choose to stop offering financial subsidy if the enterprise can obtain profit from the replacement.

articleTitle: Study on Development Pattern and Practice of Comprehensive Transport Hub
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The concept, significance and importance of comprehensive transport hub in national transportation are described in this paper. The evaluation for comprehensive transport hub is discussed in two aspects of ontology characteristics and maturity of comprehensive transport hub. The function and impact of the comprehensive transport hub are analyzed particularly, the constructed method is indicated in meanwhile. In the last part of the paper, how to build a comprehensive transport hub is described by suing a practical example. Referencing the conclusions of the paper, the constructing of comprehensive transport hub can be guided, the building level of the comprehensive transport hub can be evaluated, the service level can be enhanced, the cost of transportation can be reduced and the conveying efficiency can be strengthened.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Inventory Model with the Partial Backlogging during Shortage Period
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The characteristics of reverse logistics make the inventory management issues very complex. Once shortage happens, the reverse logistics network nodes will have insufficient workload even stop work. The previous studies about shortage more established on the assumptions of complete backlogging or complete losing, but the partial backlogging problem is less discussed. So this study develops a partial backlogging reverse logistics inventory model, and proposes a new algorithm to minimize the total cost. Finally, a practical example of the numerical analysis is given.

articleTitle: Estimating CO2 Emission and Mitigation Opportunities of Wanzhou Shipping in Chongqing Municipality, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Shipping is of great significance in the integrated transport system, however, ship emissions cannot be neglected in assessing environmental impacts of air pollution and climate change. In order to quantitatively evaluate CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission and mitigation opportunities of Wanzhou shipping in Chongqing municipality, China, we present the development of the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission inventory of Wanzhou shipping by using "top-down" method. The method contains two main parameters, which are fuel consumption and emission factor. In this paper, fuel consumption comes from statistical data provided by Harbor and Waterway Bureau in Wanzhou District, Chongqing municipality, and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission factor is set as 3179 g/kg according to relevant literatures. The results show that CO2 emission of Wanzhou shipping are 80104, 110950, 130785, 108280, 117877, and 117056 tons from 2003 to 2008, it is fluctuating with little change. At the same time, passenger and cargo turnover of Wanzhou shipping increase rapidly from 2003 to 2008, it implies the reduction of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission per unit turnover volume in recent years. Based on the development plan of Wanzhou shipping, we forecast the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission in 2011, 2015, 2020 under the two situations (baseline scenario and new policy scenario). There is an effective emission reduction under new policy scenario, compared with the baseline scenario, it can reduceCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>emission 112193.5 tons only in 2020, the reduction rate is 16.4%. In the long term, the new policy scenario will bring huge benefits for emission reductions, it also illustrates that the use of technique, management and policy strategies to reduce carbon emissions is important for shipping.

articleTitle: Tabu Search Algorithm in Solving Military Operations Other Than War Airlift Loading Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: According to the features of airlift loading, first, a mathematical model for airlift loading is established in consideration of various realistic constraints such as centre of gravity, orientation, placing order, loading capacity and so on. Then, the airlift loading problem is solved by some key issues of tabu search are discussed, including encoding, decoding, evaluation function, neighborhood operation and tabu list. A simulation example shows the method is practical and instructive.

articleTitle: Traffic Reliability Model of Single Intersection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Former research of transport reliability focuses on road network, few of which refer to the intersection traffic reliability in microcosmic level. The paper proposes the conception of traffic reliability based on which the supply-demand reciprocity is analyzed, and brings forward the methodology that the disabled condition should be differentiated according to distinct system functions. Aiming at single-intersection category, the paper analyzes main factors influencing the single-intersection reliability, and then develops two models in computing the degree of intersection reliability: The reliability model based on D/C ratio and the other one based on performance index, each of which is suitable in given presuppositions and requirements.

articleTitle: Optimal Matching of the Turbocharging Lean Burn LPG Engine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In this paper, the engine optimal matching is done to improve the efficiency of a turbocharged lean-burn LPG engine by optimizing the compression ratio and the distribution phase of camshaft. In this way, the gas consumption and emissions of the LPG engine are reduced. A one-dimensional engine model and a three-dimensional in-cylinder combustion model are set up with simulation software. The optimal compression ratio is determined by comparing the results from simulation and experiment at different compression ratios. The exhaust advance angle and valve overlap angle are optimized on the basis of successive optimization method and demonstrated in experiments.

articleTitle: Recognition for Causation Factor Characteristics of Emergency in Supply Chain Based on Principal Component and Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: To solve the problem of recognize the causation factor characteristics of emergency in supply chain in different industries, the paper established causation factor index system of emergency in supply chain based on system analytical method, and at the same time, put forward a causation factor characteristics recognition model for emergency in supply chain based on principal component analysis and clustering analysis that utilize eigenvalue and eigenvector of correlation matrix, comprehensive score of principal component and clusering. An empirical analysis is carried out to find the causation factor characteristics of IT, chemical, auto, transportation and other 6 industries under supply chain Emergency, which indicate that the established model is applicable for solving the problem.

articleTitle: Research on Logistic MIS of Garment Commodity Based on WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Logistics management is concerned with the planning, implementation and control of the movement of physical objects and the associated information. This associated information is the domain of logistics management information system (MIS). In recent years, the ability to realize the profit and strategic potential of efficient and effective logistics of garment commodity has increasingly depended on logistics MIS. Because of lacking a unified standard and solution of basic architecture and interface, traditional logistics MIS has many shortcomings, such as poor reusability and poor extensibility. In order to solve the problems, the logistics MIS of Garment Commodity based on WebGIS is proposed and analyzed. The model can build relatively independent Web Service on Intranet and Internet based on WebGIS by constructing core application program. It is easy to develop, integrate and maintain the model. The paper applies the model to the logistics MIS of Garment Commodity, which includes the management subsystem of order, electromechanical product information, bill information, and customer relations.

articleTitle: Research on Collaboration MIS of Electromechanical Enterprise Based on UML
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Companies are opening up to their partners (using instituted, regular or sporadic relations) and it is an inescapable characteristic of the market evolution. This need of networking rests on several aspects: concurrency, exchange improvement of information, products increasing complexity. This article deals with enterprise interoperability in order to research on information system design in a collaborative context. The development of collaborative management information system (MIS) relates to the knowledge of developing software and the management experience. It is necessary to change idea and pursue effective reliable method. Conceptual models developed during systems analysis are used to support understanding of and communication about the real world domain. This article introduces the design and development of the MIS of electromechanical enterprise, analyses MIS development approach based on UML and summarizes the advantage.

articleTitle: The Research of Automobile Supply Chain Based on Management and Control Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Supply chain management emphasizes the view points of integration. It makes the members of the supply chain realize the benefits maximize and achieves the integrative management of information flow , funds flow and logistics together. The paper firstly analyzes the requirements and bottlenecks in automobile SCM . Base on this, a new integrated SCM model of automobile industry is established .This model will use the management and control Integration theory . All the discussion is trying to give a solution for the difficulties in automobile industry integrated supply chain management .It is an important value that theoretical and practical.

articleTitle: Research on Model and Efficiency of Manual Order Picking Service System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Manual order picking system can be regarded as a stochastic service system when we consider order arrival as system input and order picking as service. Enhancing its efficiency is very import for increasing client's satisfaction. Basing on the picking route stochastic model under sorted storage S-type picking condition, the stochastic service time distribution is deduced, and then corresponding efficiency indicators of system are calculated. The research of this paper is able to provide reference for the estimation picking time and waiting time.

articleTitle: A Demonstration on Influencing Factors of FDI Location Choice: Based on Co-Integration and Error Correction Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Based on the relevant data in the year of 1983-2008,the paper utilizes Co-integration Test and Error Correction Model to inspect the influencing factors on FDI Location Choice in China. With a such research, the paper comes to the conclusion, that is,there is a long co-integration relation among them,fixed asset investment,R, former accumulated foreign capital amount, loan balance of financial corporation and FDI have a positive correlation, while W,the city person and FDI have a negative correlation;This paper can provide policy reference.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Railway Foundational Database Platform Architecture Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Railway Foundational Database is characterized as highly systematic, huge data volume and different data affiliation, Railway Foundational Database platform is physically distributed ,logically centralized ,easy to expand and so on. After elaborating the characteristics of Railway Foundational Data and Foundational Database Platform Architecture, we design a Foundational Database Platform Architecture based on SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture).

articleTitle: Model-Driven Approach for Logistics Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: With the further development of economic globalization, logistics enterprises are facing up to increasing competition. A model-driven development approach for logistics management information system is proposed in this paper from the viewpoint of software engineering implementation. The development process starts from the describing of platform independent models. Then, by integrating functional modules such as logistics monitoring subsystem, logistics website subsystem, storage management, the approach succeeds in transforming models between different levels. This approach can make an effect support to model driven software engineering and logistics management system. The advanced analysis and design approach can provide a guiding support for the development of general logistics management information system.

articleTitle: The Study of the Fractional Talbot Effect of a Grating and a Lens under Spherical Lightwave Illumination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: We study the fractional Talbot effect of a grating and a lens under sphere lightwave illumination in this paper. Our analysis is based on the scalar theory of optical diffraction. For simplicity we omit the influence of the finite size of the grating and the lens on the optical diffraction. We use comparing method. We change the diffraction of the optical system under sphere lightwave illumination into the diffraction of a single grating under parallel lightwave illumination. Then we present the fractional Talbot effect condition of the system under spherical lightwave illumination and analyse its characteristics. Analysis shows that the fractional Talbot effect of the system connects to wavelength of the incite light, the period of the grating, the position and the focal length of the lens and the distance of the spherical lightwave. Because more parameters are related to the fractional Talbot effect of the system, we can adjust and control the fractional Talbot effect more easily than the situation of a single grating under parallel lightwave illumination.

articleTitle: Using Cellular Network for Inner-Suburban Freeway Traffic Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: With the increase in population and rapid urban sprawl in the major big cities in China, traffic monitoring in the inner-suburban areas is becoming an urgent problem to be solved. This paper proposes using cellular network for inner-suburban freeway traffic monitoring. Backgrounds of cellular network and wireless location technologies are firstly introduced. Related works including simulation tests and field tests are reviewed. Opportunities and challenges of using cellular network for inner-suburban freeway traffic monitoring are finally discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Cycle-To-Cycle Variations of CAI Combustion Using NVO Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Based on the application of self-developed electro-hydraulic variable valve train (VVT), Controlled Auto-Ignition(CAI) was achieved with Negative Valve Overlap (NVO) strategy. This VVT system that replaced the original camshaft was mounted on the head of a modified single cylinder engine. The cycle-to-cycle variation of CAI Combustion was investigated under several different operating points with 100 consecutive cycles sampled and stored. The experimental results indicated that as the excess air coefficient increases, with fixed engine speed and valve event, the coefficient of variation of indicated mean effective pressure (CoV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IMEP</sub>) dropped firstly and then increased. The CoV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IMEP</sub> had the minimum value when the excess air coefficient ranges from 1.1 to 1.3. The engine speed and the valve lift showed the potential to influence CoV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IMEP</sub>. Increased engine speed led to a more intense mixing progress, which introduced high intensity turbulence into the cylinder and resulted in a higher level of charge homogeneity at the end of compression stroke, and finally a steady CAI combustion. Meanwhile, decreasing the valve lift had a relatively minor effect. The variation of IMEP was consequently suppressed to some extend.

articleTitle: Truck Comfort of Air Condition by Field Synergy Principle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This study is to simulate thermal comfort of passenger in the specified truck by field ynergy principle using turbulence flow to analyze input wind temperature and position, input wind u, v, w, passenger temperature, his position and thermal load. In this research, we use COMSOL software to analyze velocity and temperature fields and comfort impact of input position of wind. The results show that field synergy angle can indicate low angle increase better comfort of passenger in the specified truck.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Design and Evaluation of Signal Coordination Control System in Urban Main Road
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research of Logistics Model Decision-Making Method of Enterprises under Electronic Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Electronic commerce as a new model of business operation plays an important role in promoting global economic development. Electronic commerce is changing many aspects of logistics, and promoting the development of logistics greatly. At the same time, if there is no modern logistics, business activities will become difficult. For enterprises, the right logistics model chosen is necessary. Therefore, the scientific logistics decision-making method should be applied by enterprises for their own development. On the base of research about the logistics current situation of developed countries and developing countries, through detailing analysis and comparison three models of self-logistics, logistics outsourcing and logistics alliance, the strengths and weaknesses of different models is pointed out. Existing logistics model decision-making methods had been detailed analysis, in order to make up their flaws and shortcomings, and a new method based on logistics strategic position of enterprises has been proposed. It has some reference for logistics model decision-making of Chinese enterprises under electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Loading-Unloading Path Optimization of the AS/RS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The paper firstly analyzes the ware location assignment policy in Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems, and then optimizes the loading-unloading path. It mainly optimizes the shelves number and stacker operating order, and solves the problem of stacker operating order with the genetic algorithm. The research would optimize the loading-unloading path of the AS/RS greatly and improve the loading-unloading efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Emergency Logistics Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Abstract-The paper analyzes the performance evaluation method in urban emergency logistics. There are always some unexpected events such as natural disasters or calamities which can obstruct the smooth operation of logistics system. In severe events, failed logistics can bring urban regions to chaos. According to the principle of early warning, emergency performance evaluation should be carried out. In this paper, we incorporate a few evaluation methods such as Delphi method, AHP, fuzzy judgment, present a new comprehensive evaluation method that can take different factors of urban logistics into account.

articleTitle: Brief Description of Research on Temperature Field and Temperature Stress of Prestressed Concrete Girders
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper introduces the establishment and simplification of the temperature field and the general calculation method of temperature stress of the prestressed concrete box girders. Data from some research was extracted and the relative errors of the calculation and observation were compared. We indicate that the study of temperature field and thermal stress of prestressed concrete box girders is necessary, and will help engineers to solve the problem in structure design.

articleTitle: Enhance Stability of Traffic Flow in an Extended Car-Following Model Based on Anticipative Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: An extended car-following model is proposed by incorporating the anticipative information by vehicle to vehicle. The stability condition of the proposed model is obtained by using the linear stability theory. The results show that the anticipative information can promote the stability of traffic flow. Numerical simulations are carried out, and the results are consonant with the theory ones.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Variable Message Signs on Urban Expressway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The paper outlines the status of Variable Message Signs (VMS) on urban expressway in Beijing, and analyzes the reason for benefit generated by VMS. Firstly, the criterion system of VMS evaluation is built. Secondly, the means of data collection related to criterion system are ordered. Thirdly, the approach to VMS evaluation is determined as with or without method and cost-benefit analysis, which is based on evaluation of Intelligent Transport System. The VMS which is on the east of Jimen Bridge is evaluated as case study. Results show that VMS have a good effect on the increase of traffic flow rate, and the decrease of duration and frequency of congestion. The paper will provide scientific suggestions on evaluation of VMS in Beijing.

articleTitle: An Evaluation on Priority Lanes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Along with the economic development, cities are increasingly congested in China. In order to eliminate peak-hour congestion, many cities establish priority lanes such as bus lanes and Olympic lanes. Although priority lanes could help Local Authorities gain its short-term management objectives, at the same time, it would greatly infringe on the legitimate rights of other vehicles and waste the scarce road resources, which is rigorously proved by mathematical models in this paper. In the long run, priority lanes would make social conflicts more intensified, and therefore highly undesirable. On the contrary, the social system engineering, combined with High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lanes and High Occupancy Toll (HOT) lanes, is the right way to alleviate overcrowding and build a Low-Carbon harmonious society.

articleTitle: The Research on Characteristic of Service Innovation in Logistics Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: As the third profits source, logistics plays a more and more important role in economic development. Service innovation is a strong driving force for the development of logistics enterprise, and the research on characteristics of service innovation will provide a theoretical basis to implement innovation activities in logistics enterprise. This paper starting with the characteristics of general service innovation and combing the characteristics of logistics services, analyses the characteristics of service innovation in logistics enterprise systemically. Then it summarizes four characteristics of service innovation in logistics enterprise: complicated process, high cost, long cycle and systematic. This study enriches the basic theory research of the service innovation, which is useful to carry out the service innovation effectively and scientifically in logistics enterprise.

articleTitle: Model in Logistics Network Design for 3PL Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Logistics network design is an important strategic decision. With the development of globalization, more companies outsource their logistics and the third-party logistics companies have become the mainstream. So how to design a reasonable logistics network is important to both manufacturers and 3PL. this article analyses the situation of 3PL and provides a model in logistics network design. Finally, some suggestions are made to improve the development of 3PL.

articleTitle: Time Synchronization under 1PPS Signal with Synthetic Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Time synchronization is one of the key points in distributed real-time computer system. At first, a time synchronization method under 1PPS signal is put forth. Secondly, two kinds of relevant synthetic disturbance are analyzed, and time synchronization logic is studied to cope with the disturbance. Arena software is chosen to model and simulate the time synchronization procedure. At last, the whole simulation model is constructed and the experiment results are given out to prove the efficiency of the synchronization method.

articleTitle: Simulation of Airflow Distribution of Parallel-Type Electrostatic Fabric Filter
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The structure was introduced, status of parallel-type Electrostatic Fabric Filter were researched, and the factors influencing collection efficiency were analyzed in the paper. With software of Gambit which also meshed the calculating region, Three-dimensional structure model of the precipitator was established. And then the numerical simulation of the air distribution characteristic was carried on with software of fluent 6.2, set the boundary conditions, standard k-ε 2-equation model and SIMPLE algorithm; Then draw the path line and contour chart of the cross-section, obtained the mean square deviation value, analyzed the airflow distribution situation and the reasons for its uneven; By setting appropriate opening rate of the airflow distribution plates and collection plates to improve the air distribution situation. The results show that the airflow distribution can be uniformed by improving the opening rate of the collection plates. The numerical simulation result is more reasonable and can be used as the reference of optimizing the structural design of Electrostatic Fabric Filter.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Optimization of Multi-Project Resources Based on Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: As the complexity of under the condition of large-scaled resource-constrained multi-project duration optimization problems, it is difficult to give its analysis solution. With the network technology in this paper, taking the minimum number of the multi-project weighted duration as the goal, then establish a mathematical model for the optimization problem. In view of the basic cellular automaton topological sorting algorithm can only work on non-resource-constraints' single project tasks' topological sorting under the logic constraints relationship, this paper presents an improved cellular automaton model topological sorting algorithm to solve model. Combine several projects' network by setting virtual task nodes based on the basic cellular automata topological sorting algorithm, Start searching from the virtual node to meet the evolution rules of the Cellular Automata (satisfy the task's logic constraints and meet resources constraints) for to be activated nodes; At the same time for multiple nodes to be activated, putting forward two sort ways by: If the priority of multi-project is different (weights not equal), then activate the task in accordance with the priority of major projects to sort of small order, major priority weights; If the multi-project 's priority level is the same (weights is equal), then create a set of randomly activated sorting number with computer, and order them by these random number; Do so until all nodes are activated, thus obtain the objective function value. On this basis, and then got the resource scheduling solution of Multi-Project Time Optimization. Finally, this paper demonstrated the validity and practicality through a business case.

articleTitle: Stochastic Model and Simulation Research for Random-Storage Return-Type Manual Order Picking
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: It aims at researching the manual order picking time of logistics distribution center, tour length hence. It builds picker route stochastic model under random-storage return-type picking conditions. It makes model approximation calculation with simulation result and conducts good results under permission errors. It provides basic foundation for building random distribution function of picking time. And it establishes foundation for building random service system model of distribution center manual order picking.

articleTitle: Analysis of Freight Forwarding Time Base on Logistics Environments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In order to analyze the effects of railway productivity distribution adjustment on the timeliness of freight forwarding, on the basis of investigation and present achievement，the railway freight forwarding process and the change of each factor which affects freight forwarding time under the condition of railway productivity distribution adjustment were analyzed. The average speed of each kind of freight train including non-through train，ordinary through train and fast freight train，as well as daily average running time of heavy train was analyzed, and the statistical results were examined by adopting testing method, from which daily average running tariff kilometer was obtained. Finally，daily average running tariff kilometer before and after railway productivity distribution adjustment was compared. The analytical results show that through the adjustment of railway productivity distribution, the operating taches of railway freight forwarding gradually reduce, the primary parameters influencing all have changes to different degree, and the timeliness of railway freight forwarding improves constantly.

articleTitle: Removal of Coal-Fired Pollutants in Wet Electrostatic Precipitators with Flexible Collection Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Rigorous new regulations in coal-fired pollutants emissions by power plant have caused new demands for electrostatic precipitator (ESP) technology. The study was inspired by the requirement to use cheaper flexible polypropylene fiber and Terylene fabrics as substitutes for typical collection electrodes to save energy and structural materials, and to solve the adverse impacts caused by wet flue gas desulfurization (WFGD) and selective catalytic reduction (SCR) systems at the same time. The characteristic of flexible collection electrodes used in this work, an experimental setup and a pilot-scale unit had been illustrated. And then, contrastive distribution of non-uniform air velocity zones was investigated by a CFD model. Finally, the removals of coal-fired pollutants including acid aerosol, ammonia aerosol, slurry droplets, PM10 were performed in new wet ESPs with different assembled modes, as well as to quantify the key properties of flexible collection electrodes. The results show that the new wet ESPs were consistent with the conventional behavior of typical ESP using a thimbleful of water penetrating flexible collection electrodes via capillary flow. Performance of flexible collection electrodes were measured to exceed that of fiberglass reinforced plastics (FRP), the discharge characteristic of barbed wires was superior to that of diamond-shaped corona wires. The new wet ESP device acts in synergy with WFGD and SCR systems for controlling coal-fired pollutants emissions.

articleTitle: The Risk Modeling and Audit Supervising for Transport Public Private Partnerships in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In this paper, hierarchical holographic modeling (HHM) is used to identify the risks in transport PPPs under the perspectives of contractual nature of PPPs, institution and cultural environment, and inadequate supervision. Then, we propose that the traditional financial audit approach can not effectively control risk on PPPs, and furthermore, we give an analytic framework of audit supervision for transport PPPs by combining the approaches of modern risk-orient and performance audit to control the risks.

articleTitle: The Methods of Traffic Circle Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
