abstract: In order to eliminate accident, reduce congestion and improve the efficiency of the traffic circle, three effective and feasible methods are proposed.As an example,the traffic circle flow of the circle in Xiamen China is simulated by these methods above using VISSIM soft.The results of simulation show that three methods applied to different traffic flow each,then we did further simulations to the circle,and gave their adaptability for different traffic flow.

articleTitle: Research and Development on Safe Stowing and Securing of Vehicle on Board Ro-ro Passenger Ships
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The safety of navigation of ro-ro passenger ships has been perplexing the shipping circles, while the problem of vehicle safe stowing and securing is an important factor that affects the safe transportation of ro-ro passenger ships. Some specifications are put forward in home and abroad on the research of safe stowing and securing of vehicle on board ro-ro passenger ships. However, it is lacking in systematic demonstration and researches on them remains to be in isolation. A whole set of scientific, effective and convenient-to-use "Vehicle Securing Calculating System" and practical operation that instructs ro-ro passenger ships. The present thesis epagoges the three calculating methods of stowing and securing of vehicle on board ro-ro pessenger ships. By applying the JSP web programming technique, the "Vehicle Securing Calculating System" had been developed. What's more, this system is convenient, intuitive and easy to use. This system is applied to verify certain vehicles and its result is exactly the same with the result that is acquired through the recommended method by IMO. It also had reliazed the remote access and vehicle securing calculating.

articleTitle: Income Distribution and Dependence on Foreign Trade in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Due to the rapidly rising ratio of dependence on foreign trade, China's economic growth risk is increasing continuously. This paper analyzes the effect of widening gap of income distribution in china by establishing a simple and applicable theoretical model. The widening gap of income distribution results in shortage of domestic demand, speedy increasing of investment and the internal structural imbalance of economy; and further more, in an open economy, the structural imbalance of economy has brought about a rapidly increasing in exports and imports, making China's ratio of dependence on foreign trade grow quickly. Using the relevant data of China as empirical test, this paper proves that the widening gap of income distribution is the Granger reason of the increasing ratio of dependence on foreign trade. Therefore, taking the efficient steps to narrow the gap of income distribution is the key element to the increase of China's ratio of dependence on foreign trade.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Algorithm for Multi-Attribute Stable Bilateral Matching Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: With the increasing popularity and development of e-commerce and information technology, multi-attribute bilateral matching problem has been receiving more and more attention. In this paper, multi-attribute bilateral matching problem is discussed based on the consideration of stable matching. Concepts and definitions of multi-attribute bilateral stable matching are presented firstly, followed by the definitions and sorting rules of the matching extent. Subsequently evaluation functions and evaluation rules for the stable matching results are proposed, and then an improved state transition strategy and an improved pheromone update strategy, which are suitable for this problem, are introduced. Based on the above-mentioned preparation, this paper presents an improved ant colony algorithm, and the simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm can solve the traditional stable matching problem, and is also effective in the multi-attribute bilateral stable matching problem solving.

articleTitle: Study on Residual Life Prediction of Shipboard Cable Based on Grey Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Predicting residual life of cable plays a key role in ship management. In this paper, the Grey Linear Regression Model is used for residual life prediction of shipboard cable under influence of multi-factors. The method is proved effectively by the comparison beween the actual aging data and the data acquired by the traditional Arrhenius Equation.

articleTitle: A Novel Wideband RFID Tag Antenna
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper presents a RFID tag antenna at 900MHz which has a wide frequency band, meeting that of Chinese standard from 860MHz to 960MHz, and it possesses easy conjugate impedance matching property by adopting an arc-shaped feeding. With a typical antenna impedance of Monza3 (Impinj), the proposed tag of compact size 30×70mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has a stable performance through 100MHz frequency bandwidth.

articleTitle: Analysis of Random-Storage S-type Manual Order Picking Stochastic Service System Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Regarding order arrival obeying Poisson flow and general service distribution of single picking servicer as M/G/1 random service system, the efficiency optimal problem of manual order picking system is studied. Picking route stochastic model under random storage S-type picking condition is built. It makes model approximation calculation with simulation result under order random arrival frequencies. Well approximation between model and simulation results is obtained under the condition of permission error. The models can be used to deduce corresponding picking time distribution functions to calculate the indicators of the system. The conclusion of the paper is able to provide reference for the estimation picking time and waiting time.

articleTitle: Model of Multimodal Composite Transportation Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper analyzed the logic structure of composite transportation system which was composed of car network, bus network and urban rail network, and represented the logical relation between each modal-sub-network by building 3D model. By analyzing the constituent structure of composite network, choosing attributes and analyzing travel impedances, the composite traffic system network was established, and the traffic assignment law in the composite network was explained. Thus, a model is proposed to describe the multimodal composite transportation network. Finally, simulation process of transport planning was proposed and explained by taking Yang Hu Yuan Area planning in Changsha as an example based on TransCAD software. The results show the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Characteristic of the Inhabitant Trip in Honggu District of Nanchang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: In this paper, combining Nanchang City's transport development needs, according to residents in 2009, for the inhabitant trip in Honggu District of Nanchang, characteristic of resident trips, trip purpose, travel mode, time-consuming of the Inhabitant trip analysis of a series of indicators study. Summarized Honggu District residents travel out of the law and the reasons for variation.

articleTitle: Research on Service Positioning of Supply Chain Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper describes diverse supply chain enterprises from a different point of view-service positioning. Supply chain covers from transportation, storage, produce, distribution processing, information management, service plan and integration, to consultation. On basis of that, it's necessary for every supply chain enterprise to identify self-positioning in market competition, which, for example, includes selection on targeting area, operational commodity category and service program together with its level of difficulty. The factors affecting service positioning of supply chain enterprises and its possible trends are discussed in this article. In addition, the article reveals the fact that the precise positioning is the crucial issue needed to be considered by our domestic supply chain enterprises, the result of which may exert great impact on the competitive advantages and sustainable development of supply chain enterprises.

articleTitle: An Improved RFID Privacy Protection Scheme Based on Hash-Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is a new automatic identification technology. Widespread application of RFID may leak user's privacy. To solve this problem, an improved RFID privacy protection scheme based on Hash-chain is proposed, in which a database identifier field is introduced in RFID tag. When a RFID tag is identified by a reader, by using of the database identifier field, the reader can quickly decide whether the RFID tag belongs to the database system that the reader is associated with. Further treatment is not required if the RFID tag doesn't belong to the database system, thus the privacy of any RFID that isn't relevant with the database is protected. The identification load will be reduced remarkably and the efficiency will be improved evidently in the new authentication scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Programming Approach to Double-Level Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Under the pressure of global financial crisis, enterprises tend to enhance ability of Supply Chain Manegement (SCM) and their own advantages can be developed in the competition. A decision making model of multi-product multi-stage supply chain consisted of single manufacturer and single supplier is proposed in this article. The model is proved to be superior and efficient through application example. Reasonable decisions are suggested by analyzing the solution of dual problem. The decisions could help members of supply chain get more profits.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Key Technologies of Polymorphous and Heterogeneous Data Collection for Ocean Ship

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Functional Prototype of Radio Block Centre in the CTCS Level 3 System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: It is confirmed that the Chinese Train Control System (CTCS) level 3 system is adopted in newly-built railways where the train speed is expected to exceed 300 kilometers per hour. In order to construct the simulation and testing platform of the CTCS level 3 system, this paper focuses on the research of functional prototype of Radio Block Centre (RBC), including the following three key points. First, we find out functional requirements of RBC through a profound analysis of the CTCS level 3 system requirements. Then, we present the design of safety computer platform for RBC according to the safety requirements of train control equipments. Last, we design and accomplish the software of the RBC functional prototype on the base of the above achievements. Through the practical application in the simulation and testing platform of the newly-built railway, it is proved that the functional prototype accords with the CTCS level 3 system requirements specification and meets the construction requirements of the CTCS level 3 simulation and testing platform.

articleTitle: Posterior Probability Object Tracking Method Using Momentum Based Level Set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a novel object tracking method that is robust to a cluttered background and a large motion. First, a posterior probability measure (PPM) is adopted to locate the object region. Then the momentum based level set is used to evolve the object contour in order to improve the tracking precision. To achieve rough object localization, the initial target position is predicted and evaluated by the Kalman filter and the PPM, respectively. In the contour evolution stage, the active contour is evolved on the basis of an object feature image. This method can acquire more accurate target template as well as target center. The comparison between our method and the kernel-based method demonstrates that our method can effectively cope with the deformation of object contour and the influence of the complex background when similar colors exist nearby. Experimental results show that our method has higher tracking precision.

articleTitle: Development of Logistics Transport Equipment at Railway Crossings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: the diversity of railway gauge is caused by historical reasons, and its shortcomings have been exposed to Modern railway transportation. At present, the solutions to Logistics and transport issues between different gauge railways are mainly to change transport equipment. And different ways to replace Bogie will affect the size of the frontier transshipping station, operating efficiency and investment costs. Compared with four different methods, their strengths and weaknesses are given, and on this basis, a new structural design of bogie unit is proposed, as well as does the corresponding economic benefit analysis.

articleTitle: Developing Business Process Monitoring Strategy in a Supply Chain Using Information Requirements Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: A supply chain is a complex system with numerous members and interrelations. To be able to control and regulate the system's behavior, the different subsystems need to be monitored and the results need evaluated. Thus, a systematic approach is needed, which goal it is to provide the expected information to the right actor at the right time. This paper provides an information requirements analysis that leads to establishment of a monitoring strategy in distributed processes of a supply chain. The possible information layers in a supply chain and their information requirements will be shown. The framework is used to develope a monitoring starategy within a small case study.

articleTitle: Research on Influence of Chain Store Logistics Capability to Logistics Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Through researching the domestic and overseas literature, the paper puts forward the components of chain store logistics capability and service quality. It also develops a model to study the influence relationship between chain store logistics capability and logistics service quality. The model is developed based on the current situation and problems in Chinese chain store logistics, which not only clearly shows the directions to promote logistics service quality in chain store, but also lays the foundation for future empirical research on the model in China.

articleTitle: The New Situation of Road Safety in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Since 2003, the Chinese government has taken a series of targeted policies and measures to suppress road accidents. In recent years, in the case of the rapid economic development, rapidly growing motor vehicle amount, and changes greatly in road safety environment, China successfully achieved the objectives that road accidents from the peak to be suppressed, until to the decline year-by-year. The situation of road safety in China has been improved every year. The development of road safety in China is reviewed, and the new changes of road safety circumstance in recent years and the characteristics of road accidents are analyzed. Although the road safety has made great achievements in China, there is a large gap compared with the developed countries. The pressure to further improve road safety is growing, and road safety is facing the enormous challenges and new opportunities.

articleTitle: Co-Ordinative Stock Management System for Permissible Storage in VMI Pattern
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: this paper focuses on the establishment of storage management models for permissible shortage and comparison between stock management systems with and without shortage. Through the comparison a relevant optimization strategy is brought up. Furthermore, this paper reveals that the supply chain system could run more efficiently with an establishment of a permissible shortage model in VMI pattern under certain conditions, especially when storage cost is higher than shortage cost.

articleTitle: The Study of Tripper Choice Behavior Theory and Model under the Guiding Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Under the analysis of the present situation of urban roads at home and abroad, the paper reviews the development of tripper guiding information system, traffic-flow distribution model and route choice model. Then it has three multi-attribute decision-making model based on the influence factors of tripper route choice and uncertainty theories, in order to analyze the decision-making process of tripper route choice, designed to provide theoretical basis for managers when they making guiding information strategy and optimizing the traffic-flow.

articleTitle: Research on the Range of Indirect Impact by Expressway Traffic Accidents in Road Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: A serious highway accident with long duration will lead to a great delay. If the extended travel time is beyond travelers' tolerance, they will make a detour by choosing any other roads. However, the driver's behavior of taking other routes will make an impact on the surrounding road network. Thus that impact is called the indirect impact by highway traffic accidents in road network. The range of indirect impact normally includes parallel lines of road incident, traffic flowing into the upstream highway incident of road and important nodes.

articleTitle: Design of a Safety Protocol in Railway Signaling Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The railway signaling system is a safety related system composed of several sub-systems which have to exchange information with each other. As the communication system may be subjected to intentional or unintentional external attacks, the application of specific safety techniques is necessary. In this paper, a safety protocol is designed. Compared with the general TCP/IP protocol, a safety layer, on which several safety measures are applied to defense against the possible threats or attacks, is inserted between the top application layer and the lower transmission layer. The result illustrates that the designed protocol conforms to the international standard EN50129, and can switch the system to a fail-safe state when an unexpected failure or error occurs.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Consumers' Decision When Simultaneous Use of Auction and Posted Price
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: By constructing the exponential delay cost function, we formulate the consumer decision model based on the threshold strategies in dual-mechanism, and prove that there exists a unique symmetric Nash equilibrium in which the high-valuation consumers use a threshold policy to choose between the two selling channels. Then we extend our model under general delay cost function, and find that consumers with higher valuation will choose threshold strategies to make decision once arriving at websites only if the delay cost function of them continuous strict increases with the auction remaining time.

articleTitle: Road Safety Evaluation Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Evaluating road safety is essential in identifying the potential road safety hazard which could result in casualties and property losses. in this paper, a BP neural network was built by using neural network toolkit in "Matlab", Two similar roadways are used in calibrating and validating the network. The high level of predictability provided that the application of BP neural network model to road safety evaluation is feasible, and evaluation results coincide with the actual situation.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Delay Time of Train Entering Station Process with Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Computerized interlocking systems have been studied for many years. Available interlocking systems mainly are centralized control systems. The great progress of distributed control technology and intelligent terminals make it possible to develop distributed interlocking system. To standardize operations of devices in distributed railway signaling system, this article takes the process of train entering the station as the focal point and models it with GSPN. To ensure the model safety, the structural properties are verified with the reachability set. Finally, the relationship between the throughput ability of station and parameters of system delay time are analyzed, including the time of route request, the interval of train request, and the polled time in station. In addition the standard operation time of devices is evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on Early-Warning Model for Food Supply Chain Risk Based on Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: To find the risks in food supply chain and to take appropriate measures to guard against risks and increase capacity of food supply chain to resist risks. The paper established Logistic regression early-warning model to recognise magnitude of risks based on principal component analysis and Logistic regression analysis. An empirical analysis is carried out to test the model by take out some food enterprises randomly as analytic samples and calculate their risk indices in supply chain. The result shows this method is applicable to food supply chain risk early-warning.

articleTitle: Security Evaluation of Urban Rail Transit Operation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Index structure system of urban rail transit is analyzed and optimized by applying information entropy. In this paper, a security evaluating C2R model on analyzing urban rail transit is set up based on DEA. Finally, a case study about Guangzhou Metro Line 1 is carried out, and annual relative validity of subway operation safety is evaluated by using the Matlab software program. According to the results of the calculation, in invariable circumstances of output indexes, adjust to input indexes of non-DEA effective Decision Making Units. At last, the conclusion according to the front real analysis and suggestions as well as the countermeasures is elicited.

articleTitle: A Literature Review of Value Configuration Analysis and Supply Chain Coordination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: This paper performs a literature review research of value configuration analysis (VCA) and its application in supply chain coordination. By reviewing the theory of VCA and its application in supply chain management, it analyzes theoretical and managerial implications for supply chain coordination based on in-depth exploring the range of the VCA theory. By so doing, it concludes that the dynamic capabilities, the interfaces, and the appropriate governance mechanisms concerning VCA are interesting insights in supply chain coordination.

articleTitle: A Study on the Layout of Multi-NEMLCs When Knowing the Selected Place
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Engineering and Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: The problem of the layout of NEMLCs (National Economic Mobilization Logistics Centers) is one of the most important long-term decision-making issues. The result of NEMLCs's layout directly impacts many aspects of mobilization, such as time, reliability, quality, efficiency, cost, and so on, consequently affects the effect of the mobilization. Under the restriction of mobilization time, the paper establishes the layout model that several mobilization logistics centers provide the material to the mobilization demanding place. The mobilization goods or service can reach the demanding place to carry into mobilization execution within the given time, and the number of the built NEMLCs is the least.
